entities.summary: Roopa Unnikrishnan is an Indian-born American sports shooter and innovation consultant, based in New York City. She serves as the Senior Vice President of Strategy and Corporate Development of IDEX Corporation. In 1998, she was the first Indian woman to ever win a gold medal at the Commonwealth Games, in the 50m rifle prone position event.
